historical_record.description: The City Planning Commission voted 5-2 to refuse the tentative map to convert the building, the former nurses' offices and residence, into 15 condominiums, to keep rental housing in the Pine-Bush corridor (Resolution 8176).
By February 1979 the building, formerly nurses' offices and a nurses' residence, held 15 apartments being renovated, with no parking.
